projects.title: Covered-Call Candidate Watchlist Labels
projects.aggregation: DAY; cached candle-session flag false; LAST price
projects.description: Displays BUY/HOLD/AVOID labels from stock price, implied-volatility range rank, average volume, RSI, EMA trend and ATR conditions.
projects.usage: Create a Custom Quote using the source text. Match the cached daily aggregation and LAST price setting. CC Indi and CC Indi2 are exact duplicate definitions.
projects.caveats: BUY is a subset of HOLD, so both labels can be true at once. No division-by-zero guard is present in the implied-volatility rank. The script does not inspect option chains, spread, expiry, premium, 100-share affordability or the actual account.

projects.usage: Create a Custom Quote in a watchlist, paste the source, and select its aggregation. Read GCRSignal: -1 bearish setup, 0 neutral, +1 bullish setup. As a chart study, the delivered source shows its numeric plot; optional price overlays remain commented out.
projects.caveats: Stochastic and divergence logic are disabled in the saved source. strongBearish and strongBullish therefore remain false, so the advertised -2/+2 codes and strong-signal alerts cannot occur.
